title: Beef Shawarma Bowl
description: A flavorful and healthy Egyptian-inspired beef shawarma bowl, served over a bed of light salad and steamed vegetables.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced beef (such as ribeye or sirloin)

ingredients.name: Light salad
ingredients.notes: Mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, carrots

ingredients.name: Egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, paprika, and cayenne pepper

instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, mix together the beef, Egyptian spices, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
3. Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
4. Meanwhile, prepare the light salad by mixing together the greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and carrots.
5. Warm the bowl by placing it in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for 5 minutes.
6. Assemble the shawarma by placing the grilled beef on top of the salad in the bowl.
7. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with feta cheese (if using).
